INTRO.PARAGRAPH_1: No matter your age, you have rights and particularly the right to protect your personal data and your privacy.
INTRO.PARAGRAPH_2: Online, you can decide what can be seen of you, and what the social media do with your information.

INCOGNITO.TITLE: 🗑️ The right to erasure: Stay incognito
INCOGNITO.PARAGRAPH_1: Online, you have the right to request the erasure and dereferencing of your data. Concretely, if you want a photo, a video, a text from you, your name, your first name or any other elements of your personal data to be deleted or to no longer appear in search engine queries, you can request it to the relevant sites.
INCOGNITO.PARAGRAPH_2: You can address the site or platform directly. If the platform doesn't answer your requesti within 1 month, you can report it to you national Data Protection Authorities and get some help enforcing your rights.

DATA_INFO.TITLE: ℹ️ The right to information: who does what with my data
DATA_INFO.PARAGRAPH: You have the right to know what the sites, games, applications and other platforms do, want to do or are planning to do with your personal data.

RIGHT_TO_OBJECT.TITLE: ❌ The right to opposition: keep control of your data
RIGHT_TO_OBJECT.PARAGRAPH: You have the right to oppose to the use of your data by websites or apps (except in very specific cases foreseen by law).

PORTABILITY.TITLE: 🧳 The right to portability: where I want, when I want!
PORTABILITY.PARAGRAPH_1: You even have the right to carry your data and use it elsewhere, « in mode » « click and collect »! This is data portability.
PORTABILITY.PARAGRAPH_2: You retrieve and use them elsewhere, with a competitor, if you want. This applies to your photos, audios or videos, or for your courses on a note-taking application on your computer.

P1.TITLE: What's the role of the CNIL?
P1.DESCRIPTION: The role of a data protection authority is to preserve the liberties of each one of us. It advises and controls the use of personal data by companies, administrations and associations.

P2.TITLE: Why do I have to wait for an answer for 1 month? ⏱️
P2.DESCRIPTION: It's the legal delay. That means that the law leaves 1 month to the platform to reply to you (according to the General Data Protection Regulation, or GDPR).

P3.TITLE: What's an an incomplete or a wrong reply? 📝
P3.DESCRIPTION: The platform didn't take into account all of your request or the answer doesn't fit what you asked for.

HAVE_ACCESS.TITLE: I still have access to my account
HAVE_ACCESS.DESCRIPTION: Some steps to take back the control of your account

A1.TITLE: Change your password
A1.LONG_DESCRIPTION: Create a strong password for your account right away. FantomApp can help you check if your password is easily discoverable.

A2.TITLE: Enable two-factor authentication
A2.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
The two-factor authentication adds an extra protecion to your account. Even if someones finds your password, they won't be able to log-in without a second code (received by text ou via an app).
👉 It's like a second lock to your door.

A3.TITLE: Check your information
A3.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Check that your email address and phone number were not changed
A3.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
📲 Were your contacts, publications or bank details (if you provided them) modified?

If you see a phone number or an address that your don't recognise:
  • Take a screenshot to keep as proof.
  • Change them immediately

A4.TITLE: Check who's connected to your account
A4.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Check if any unknown devices are connected to your account
A4.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
Go to your account settings and disconnect all devices that were authorised so far.
❌ If you see a device or connection you don't recognise:
  • Take a screenshot to keep as proof
  • Disconnect it immediately

A1.TITLE: Notify your friends and contacts
A1.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: They may receive or have received strange messages
A1.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
📢 Tell your contacts (friends, family...) that your account has been hacked.
⚠️ They may receive messages from someone pretending to be you. Tell them not to reply or click on any links.

A2.TITLE: Change your other passwords
A2.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
If you use the same password on other websites or apps, change it there too.
👉 This will prevent other accounts from being hacked as well.

A3.TITLE: Notify your bank
A3.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Take action if your bank details were on your account
A3.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
💳 If your bank details (clike your card numbner) were accessibles on the hacked account, you have to tell an adult immediately.
You must notify your bank as soon as possible, and block your card if necessary to prevent any theft.

A4.TITLE: Use a password keeper
A4.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
🔐 A password keeper is an app or a tool on your phone that keeps all your passwords safe. It can also create very strong passwords for each website or app and fill them in automatically when you log in.
👉 It's like a digital safe for all your accounts.

A5.TITLE: Never share your password
A5.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: It's best to keep them for yourself
A5.LONG_DESCRIPTION:
Someone could read your messages, post on your behalf or steal your account.
Your password is personal, just like your phone's passcode.
